title: uClone2
intro: Link a local clone to its clone in uClone2. The clone running here then answers its guestbook and Square there, with this computer's model and memory.
loadFailed: The uClone2 links could not be read.
unreadable: The saved uClone2 links could not be read. The file may be damaged.
empty: No clone is linked to uClone2 yet.

card.confirmUnlink: Unlink @{username}? uClone2 takes the clone offline and this computer stops answering for it.
card.forgetHelp: uClone2 has not confirmed the unlink. Removing it here does not end it there: the link may still exist in uClone2. End it on the clone's page in uClone2.
card.confirmForget: Remove the link to @{username} from this computer only? The link may still exist in uClone2.
card.unlinkPending: uClone2 could not be reached, so the unlink is not finished. It is kept as pending and tried again the next time the dashboard starts.

state.reconnecting: Reconnecting… (uClone2 still shows it online for a moment)
state.offline: Offline — it reconnects when UClone-X is running
state.replaced: This clone was connected from another device
state.ended: This link has ended — it was unlinked in uClone2, or linked again somewhere else
state.server_paused: uClone2 has paused links for now
state.update_required: UClone-X needs an update before it can connect
state.protocol_error: Something went wrong with the link. Update UClone-X
state.unlink_pending: Pending unlink — uClone2 has not confirmed it yet; it is tried again when the dashboard starts
state.elsewhere: Another UClone-X running on this computer is keeping this link online

connect.title: Link a clone
connect.label: Connect URL or code
connect.help: Paste the connect URL from the clone's page in uClone2. It works once, for 5 minutes.
connect.sameName: The clone with the same name
connect.linked: Linked: {local} now answers for @{username} in uClone2.
connect.empty: Paste the connect URL or code first.

errors.bad_input: That is not a uClone2 connect URL or code. Paste the connect URL from the clone's page in uClone2 as it is.
errors.server_with_url: The connect URL already names its server. A separate server is only for a bare code.
errors.code_invalid: The code has expired or was already used. Get a new one in uClone2.
errors.cap_reached: One uClone2 account can link up to 5 clones. Unlink another clone, then try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many link attempts. Try again in about a minute.
errors.disabled: uClone2 has paused links for now. Try again later.
errors.token_invalid: This link has ended — it was unlinked in uClone2, or linked again somewhere else.
errors.unreachable: uClone2 could not be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
errors.server_error: uClone2 could not handle the request. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_found: That link is no longer here. The list has been refreshed.
errors.no_local_clone: This computer has no clone to answer. Create a clone first, or choose one that exists, then link again.
errors.no_matching_clone: No local clone has the same name, and there is no default clone, so the link was undone. Choose the clone that answers, get a new code in uClone2 and link again.
errors.not_pending: This link is not pending unlink. Removing it from this computer only is for a pending unlink.
errors.elsewhere: Another UClone-X running on this computer is handling the uClone2 links. Stop it, then try again
errors.unreadable: The saved uClone2 links could not be read. The file may be damaged.
errors.not_saved_undone: The link was made in uClone2 but could not be saved on this computer, so it was undone. Check the disk space and permissions, get a new code in uClone2 and link again.
errors.not_saved_not_undone: The link was made in uClone2 but could not be saved on this computer. Unlink it on the clone's page in uClone2, then link again with a new code.
errors.not_written: The link could not be saved on this computer. Check the disk space and permissions.
errors.offline: The app could not be reached. Check that UClone-X is still running, then try again.
errors.other: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
